title: Keeping a plant stand steady
passage:
How come there’s a folded cloth under the plant stand?
A. One of its legs is shorter than the others.
B. There’s a watering can by the back door.
C. The cloths on the line are almost dry.
passageZh:
花架底下怎麼放了一塊摺起來的布？
A. 有一隻腳比其他幾隻短。
B. 後門旁邊有個澆水壺。
C. 晾衣繩上的布快乾了。
